searchText: Is finding peers on Sepolia extremely slow for others as well? I started some new nodes and several minutes later they still have mostly between 0 and 4 peers. I guess most clients don’t yet have the DNS configuration for Sepolia added, as it’s fairly new. Just today I added it to Besu and could do a snap sync in just a few minutes, with a steady number of peers.
